correctness.rationale: Exact exponential first-arrival decomposition gives three coupled rational path recurrences. Each Taylor coefficient through order three has an affine closed form on the tail; after clearing denominators the inductive residual is degree at most two in path half-length, and three explicit exact base instances establish the identity. The cycle decomposition and short-loop cases then follow. Independent rational graph-mask verification confirms 18 finite instances; no finite check is mistaken for an infinite proof. All error terms fix cycle size.

value.rationale: Site-dependent attempt rates are a physically motivated perturbation in hard-core irreversible adsorption. The result gives an explicit third-order strong-contrast correction per cell for all even cycles of length at least ten and identifies the precise shorter-loop exceptions at lengths 4, 6 and 8. This is an infinite structural stabilization law and a useful exact benchmark for finite-lattice kinetic computations, not an arbitrary isolated rational value.
